meta.title: Dremu Chart Studio
meta.description: A full-page chart studio for Gorge / Dremu .g chart projects: create a new project, timeline editing, a vertical judgement-line note editor (position × time with a spectrum strip), an inspector, a docked piecewise curve panel, multi-clip audio periods, playback, undo/redo, and ZIP package export, reading and writing the .g staff files on disk; the agent can create a project and edit the same chart with the gorge_project_create / gorge_chart_get / gorge_chart_edit tools and changes appear live in the editor.
